brief: Global weather extremes dominate today's news with record heat and flooding, while a kidnapped missionary is freed and a stolen Matisse is recovered. Research highlights ethical concerns in visualization and AI's organizational impacts.
news_summary: Extreme weather hits Europe and Asia with wildfires and unprecedented rain, while Moldova faces Russian interference, a US missionary is released in Niger, and a stolen Matisse is found in Brazil.
papers_summary: Papers explore ethical gaps in IEEE VIS research, AI adoption in organizations, and novel methods in visualization and HCI.

zh.brief: 今日中文新闻聚焦台湾前总统女儿离婚案引发的媒体伦理讨论、C919首飞国际航线以及AI对就业的影响；学术方面则关注IEEE VIS论文伦理审查和AI写作工具的研究。
zh.news_summary: 台湾前总统陈水扁女儿陈幸妤离婚消息成为舆论焦点，引发对媒体伦理的反思；中国国产C919完成首次国际商业航班，挑战波音和空客；此外，AI浪潮冲击青年就业，美军航母官兵生活条件也引发担忧。
zh.papers_summary: 有研究指出超过63%的IEEE VIS论文可能面临撤稿风险，引发对学术伦理的关注；另一项研究探讨了AI辅助写作工具中行为可控性和详细度的影响。

todays_image.caption: Like the cape in the public domain image jutting into open waters, Chen Hsing-yu's sudden media reappearance after 20 years thrusts her back into the public eye as a striking, solitary figure.
todays_image.title: Fair Mount Company Cape
